chapter: England, Paris and memories of Kansas City and Harlem
title: Nothing rubbed off on her in Kansas City
summary: She says music was all that mattered, staying up days and nights playing.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: While you were in Kansas City, musically did anything rub off on you? Did you have something that you were never doing before?

No, nothing rubbed off on me. I think music was such a great thing that you could hit me on top of the head and I wouldn't know. All I did was just stay up nights, days and nights, playing. Joe Smith that married Louise Mann - you remember Joe Smith the trumpet player that was with McKinney's Cotton Pickers?
Right. I think he was with Henderson too.
